deploy-bot: Initiating staging deploy · env=staging · tag=release/v2.4.1-beta1 · commit=f7d2e9a · initiated_by=@anna

deploy-bot: Change window 2025-06-14 03:15–03:30 UTC · estimated duration ~9m · CI: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/4257

anna: kicking off canary at 5% now. will run quick smoke suite (text-gen + reranker) and sanity checks.

infra-oncall: spinning up synthetic traffic and db warmers, posting smoke outputs in ~2m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

kevin: seeing a handful of 504s from canary pods, looks like sidecar keepalive mismatch. pausing rollout and pinning at 5%.

anna: acknowledged. holding traffic. creating rollback note in ops board: revert -> tag release/v2.4.0 if unresolved in 10m.

infra-oncall: root cause: new image omitted env var `MAX_KEEPALIVE=0` which triggers older sidecar behavior. patching configmap and rolling restart of canary pods now.

kevin: restarted pods are back up. tail latency improving, 99p back to baseline after 90s warmup. rerunning smoke set "checkout flow" — no regressions so far.

sam: verified reranker CPU up ~6% but within budget. logging note for docs to expect slight CPU bump for this model variant.

anna: thanks — resuming traffic shift. will step to 30% then 70% then 100%, holding 3m at each step to watch errors and queues.

deploy-bot: Traffic advanced to 30% · monitoring window 3m · current status: canary recovering

kevin: 3m window clear, advancing to 70%. keeping concurrency throttle to `CONCURRENCY=48` for the next step.

oliver: quick release-notes reminder: include sidecar env fix and batching default tweak (8 → 12) for small-batch jobs. tag product docs to review.

deploy-bot: Traffic advanced to 70% · monitoring window 3m

kevin: final 3m looks good. promoting to 100% now. no further holds.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy completed · env=staging · tag=release/v2.4.1-beta1 · commit=f7d2e9a · duration=12m · artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.example/releases/v2.4.1-beta1 · changelog: https://changelog.redwood.example/2.4.1-beta1

anna: running post-deploy smoke for 20m, will flag if anything odd shows up. nice teamwork :party_parrot:

deploy-bot: Note: no rollback executed. If QA or customers surface issues, please file an incident and include label `deploy:release/v2.4.1-beta1` for audit traces.

oliver: tagging this thread for release notes and internal rollout checklist. thanks team! :tada:
